research_rationale:
EO 11195 (1965-01-30, 30 FR 1169) amends EO 11189 of November 23, 1964 by adding to its section 1 the Chief of Protocol, Department of State, as an additional Level IV position and to its section 2 three additional Level V positions (Staff Director, Commission on Civil Rights; Assistant Director (Program Planning, Analysis and Research), Office of Economic Opportunity; General Counsel, Veterans Administration), under section 303(g) of the Government Employees Salary Reform Act of 1964, and takes effect immediately. I read the full held Federal Register text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11195.txt, 30 FR 1169, PDF pages 5-5) and confirmed its number, title and date against the census register. The dossier's seven clauses (two amendment leads, four added positions and the effective-date sentence) cover every sentence of the order, so I confirm the inventory. EO 12060 (signed 1978-05-15) revokes the order by number in its section 3, and the dossier carries the ACT record for it. The first end of every clause is that express revocation. Amendments continue until the amended order ends under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments, and EO 11189 was revoked by the same sentence. Earlier candidate end that does not name this order, disclosed under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments (option C; it is not the end because it does not name EO 11195): Pub. L. 89-554 (Sept. 6, 1966, 80 Stat. 378), which enacted title 5 of the United States Code, lists in 5 U.S.C. 5315 the Chief of Protocol, Department of State, as item (73), and in 5 U.S.C. 5316 the Assistant Director (Program Planning, Analysis and Research), Office of Economic Opportunity as item (101), the General Counsel of the Veterans' Administration as item (110) and the Staff Director, Commission on Civil Rights as item (114), so every position this order added appears in the statute (held at jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_11195_Pub._L._89-554_Sept._6_1966_80_Stat._378_et_seq._including_5_U.S.C._5315_and_5316_as__c629b8a1e7.txt). The Federal Register catalog note on EO 11189 says that statute "Nullified by 80 Stat. 460, 461 (5 U.S.C. 5315, 5316)" EO 11189 and EO 11195 because it included all positions they added (jobs/later-events/output/CATALOG_INDEX.csv), but the catalog note on EO 11195 itself records only the EO 12060 revocation. Section 7(c) of the same Act says an order in effect under a replaced law continues in effect under the corresponding provision "until repealed, amended, or superseded", which points the other way. I did not establish that the statute extinguished this order, so EO 12060 is recorded as the first end. The 5 U.S.C. 5317 note in the U.S. Code release point also records that this order was revoked by EO 12060. Bounded search read for this order: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121 through 2026-10-09; eCFR and GovInfo CFR bulk through 2026-10-14; Federal Register catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts), after reading their coverage notes, which carry no coverage warning; the Cruden by-number scan of held order texts in the packet's LOOKUPS.md; and a full read of EO 12553 (held FR text, 33,227 characters).
